heading: ### Triggers T1–T3 and the re-pin rule

findings.quote:
instances at round 8 (2026-10-14): tsukuroi `084951be…` (6/10) → `bba6cdf6…`; mado
  `d7edaab4…` (4/10) → `90d50cdd…` → `7da4ec50…` (both have moved again since; re-read, never carry).
findings.why: Minor record-precision gap, residual from round 27 (ReRead07 MG1, Read15 MG6) and unapplied at C0. The artifact the trigger rests on records the mado live reading as `dc864c6a…` (2 186 L, worktree dirty) and the reading as `stale + drift` (corpus/knowledge/fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md:302), with `90d50cdd…` only as the HEAD blob of that read. The section lists the HEAD blob as the instance a reader should re-measure and drops both the dirty live bytes and the drift qualifier, so a reader following T1's own action ('re-measure at the live revision') is pointed at a blob the cited ledger row does not call the live reading. The chain itself is otherwise correct: all three mado blobs are committed on 2026-10-14 (eead56b2 14:33:30 -03:00 → d7edaab4, 0c20a76f 16:06:31 → 90d50cdd, 12c8f08a 16:55:09 → 7da4ec50) and tsukuroi's 084951be (165307fe) → bba6cdf6 (aa136d69 and 72b038da) also holds.

Minor pointer-precision gap only (the labels are true). .ufo/waves/round-16/w2/RerunSweep.md:93 at C0 reads 'durations, and the tool sha (75ed934d → 89722ddb, the commit-expected r16 tool —': it carries the sha, not the date 18:28 nor the version label r10-2. r10-2 is stated at :22 ('the recorded 13:40:15Z sweep ran 75ed934d…adc5 (r10-2, pre-ledger-embedding)'), the 18:28 stamp is commit 606716f7's committer time (2026-10-14T18:28:23-03:00, blob 75ed934d), and the label is corroborated at corpus/knowledge/closeout-r11.md:69. A pointer of «RerunSweep.md:21-23» (or a ledger/closeout citation) would carry the whole parenthetical; :93 carries only the sha.
